description: Named entities in a text or a page: people, organisations, places, dates and money amounts (from the chat model), plus e-mail addresses, URLs and phone numbers (from patterns), each de-duplicated with a count. With url, the page's readable text is used (robots.txt is respected). Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
